title: alchemilla exigua
intro: Alchemilla exigua, commonly known as the small lady's mantle or mountain alchemilla, is a plant species belonging to the Rosaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions, including inflammation, digestive issues, and skin problems, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Alchemilla exigua include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and astringent properties, which contribute to its healing effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, tannins, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
